Assessment Criteria
 
Notes: Performance against criteria
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Overall communicative effectiveness
 
OK
• Intro questions• Reassurance good• Answered patient questions with directly relevant answers
Could be improved
• Assumptions about patient weight and diet• Volume low–sometimes hard to hear
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Intelligibility
 
OK
• Pronunciation generally good
Could be improved
• but some issue with volume and tone
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Fluency
 
OK
• Some delay - not much
Could be improved
• Needed prompting - could have asked questions
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Appropriateness of language 
 
OK
• Generally understandable by non-expert• 'Micturation' - then explained
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Resources of grammar and expression
 
OK
• Sentence structure generally OK • Vocabulary generally alright–some choice could be better
Could be improved
• Tone–little variation of tone to effect meaning• Vocabulary–'Fatty people'; 'Sweety juice', 'Symptoms of thirsty'
 
 

 


 
Mark: Borderline pass level performance
